learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will learn to connect sentences using advanced conjunctions of reason, result, contrast, and condition, such as because, so, therefore, although, and if.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Conjunctions are the super-glue of English! They stick short sentences together to make long, beautiful ones. Today, we'll learn the glue that shows 'why' things happen and 'what' happens next! 🌉

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we want to explain WHY something happened, we use conjunctions of reason. 'Because' and 'since' give the cause or the reason behind an action.
examples_or_templates: I wore a jacket because it was cold. (Reason: it was cold)
Since you are tired, you should rest. (Reason: you are tired)

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we want to show WHAT happened as a result of an action, we use 'so' or 'therefore'. It's the opposite of a reason!
examples_or_templates: It was raining heavily, so the match was cancelled. (Result: match cancelled)
She studied hard; therefore, she scored the highest marks.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: 'Although' and 'Though' show a surprise or contrast (two opposite ideas). 'If' sets a condition (something will happen ONLY when something else happens first).
examples_or_templates: Although he was hurt, he finished the race. (Surprise/Contrast)
If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go to the park. (Condition)

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which conjunction fits best? 'I missed the bus _______ I woke up late.'
❓ Choose the correct word: '______ you eat your vegetables, you can have dessert.'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Join these sentences using 'so': 'I forgot my lunch. I am very hungry.'
subjective_practice.hint: Put the reason first, then the word 'so', and then the result.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: '_______ the puzzle was difficult, she solved it quickly.'
subjective_practice.hint: Use a word that shows a surprising contrast.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Complete the sentence with your own idea: 'I was feeling sick, therefore...'
subjective_practice.hint: What was the result of feeling sick? Did you go to the doctor?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🔗 The Chain Reaction Game
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write a funny chain of events using 'Because' and 'So'. Example: 'The dog barked BECAUSE it saw a cat, SO the cat ran up a tree, BECAUSE...'

chapter_summary: ⭐ 'Because' and 'Since' explain the reason why something happened.
⭐ 'So' and 'Therefore' explain the result or consequence of an action.
⭐ 'Although/Though' show contrast, and 'If' sets a condition for an action.
